method: Whole-bar boundaries from mel and MFCC/chroma novelty, cross-checked against per-bar 40-140 Hz kick energy and vocal-stem activity. Names follow the audio; the Suno running order is only a vocabulary guide.

sections.name: Intro
sections.label: breakbeat grows; opening vocal calls
sections.evidence: kick lifts at bar 10; vocals enter in bar 13; full kick and bass enter at bar 30

sections.name: Groove / Drop A
sections.label: full kick and bass; first vocoder hook
sections.evidence: kick 0.16 to 0.75 at bar 30; first full Gateway hook spans roughly bars 38-45

sections.name: Build
sections.label: drums strip back and rebuild
sections.evidence: kick 0.68 to 0.23 and RMS 0.79 to 0.38 at bar 54; energy rises into bar 70

sections.name: Groove / Hook B
sections.label: spoken bridge, vocoder and two-bar cut
sections.evidence: full kick returns at bar 70; two-bar drum cut at 78-79; new phrase at 80; one-bar cut at 95

sections.name: Groove C
sections.label: partial drums, shout tails, then full drive
sections.evidence: drums return partially at 96 and fully at 104; kick and RMS collapse into 112-113

sections.name: Breakdown
sections.label: drums cut; rhythmic vocal chops
sections.evidence: kick falls to 0.15 at bar 113; a seven-bar truncated phrase leads directly to the return at 120

sections.name: Rebuild
sections.label: kick and bass return for eight bars
sections.evidence: kick 0.23 to 0.90 and RMS 0.46 to 0.92 at bar 120; exact eight-bar phrase

sections.name: Climax
sections.label: maximum drive, staggered breaks, final hook begins
sections.evidence: highest RMS/kick from bar 128; cuts at 137 and 140, spoken reprise at 141-143, vocoder hook from 144

sections.name: DJ Outro
sections.label: final hook resolves; drums continue and fade
sections.evidence: kick 0.02 to 0.80 at bar 150; vocals end in bar 158; layers thin sharply at bars 173-175
